raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.2.0"

package:
  name: medpython
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/m/medpython/medpython-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: eeee5a38889fe3a30241ac115fc20614c03a227a1653e775c54a0af503f6b8f4

build:
  number: 3
  script:
    - if: win
      then:
        - set "CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=v143"
        - set "CXXFLAGS=%CXXFLAGS% /openmp:llvm"
    - python -m pip install . --no-deps -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake
    - make
    - swig
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools >=61.0
    - wheel
    - numpy
    - pip
    - eigen
    - libboost-headers
    - libxgboost ==2.0.3
    - dmlc
    - nlohmann_json
    - liblightgbm ==4.6.0
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
      else: llvm-openmp
  run:
    - python
    - pandas
    - plotly
    - numpy
    - medpython-etl
    - libxgboost ==2.0.3

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - med
        - AlgoMarker
      pip_check: true

  - script:
      - python tests/run_all.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - requests
    files:
      recipe:
        - tests/

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Medial-EarlySign/medpython
  documentation: https://medial-earlysign.github.io/MR_Wiki
  repository: https://github.com/Medial-EarlySign/medpython
  summary: Medial EarlySign Python Library for Electronical Medical Records
  description: |
    Medial EarlySign Infrastructure for machine learning on Electronical Medical Records
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENCE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - alonyado

about.description: Medial EarlySign Infrastructure for machine learning on Electronical Medical Records
about.summary: Medial EarlySign Python Library for Electronical Medical Records
